title: Summit Club Change Terms Table — Upgrade Credit, Downgrade and Transfer
content:
Change terms of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships: whether a membership may be upgraded to a higher membership during the membership year, what credit the current dues give on that upgrade, whether it may be downgraded before its renewal date, and whether it may be transferred to another person.

| Membership | Upgrade to a higher membership during the year | Credit given for the current dues on an upgrade | Downgrade before the renewal date | Transfer to another person |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | Permitted | Prorated over the remaining months | Not permitted | Not permitted |
| Summit Club Individual | Permitted | Prorated over the remaining months | Not permitted | Not permitted |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | Permitted | Prorated over the remaining months | Not permitted | Not permitted |
| Summit Club Executive | Not permitted | None | Not permitted | Not permitted |
| Summit Club Corporate | Not permitted | None | Not permitted | Not permitted |
| Summit Club Lifetime | Not permitted | None | Not permitted | Not permitted |

## Notes

- **Upgrades.** Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual and Summit Club Individual Plus may be upgraded during the year, and on each the credit for the current dues is prorated over the remaining months. Summit Club Executive, Summit Club Corporate and Summit Club Lifetime may not be upgraded during the year, and their credit basis is none.
- **Downgrades.** No membership in the range may be downgraded before its renewal date.
- **Transfers.** No membership in the range may be transferred to another person.
